Naona Moru Camp
Where sweeping plains meet untamed beauty.
Perched beside the iconic Moru Kopjes, Naona Moru Camp offers a luxurious escape with sweeping views of the Serengeti’s southern plains. This intimate camp of just 11 tented suites blends comfort, elegance, and the untamed beauty of Africa. Whether sipping an aperitif as the sun dips below the horizon or listening to the nocturnal calls of the wild from your private suite, every moment here feels extraordinary.
Each spacious suite is a sanctuary, featuring crisp white linens, soothing neutral tones with vibrant accents, and a Victorian desk to chronicle your adventures. Amenities include a cozy seating area, and en-suite bathrooms with hot running water and large showers. Large netted windows allow for serene breezes, while the private verandah invites you to relax as the Serengeti unfolds before your eyes.
Perfectly positioned for year-round exploration and conveniently located with access to the Seronera Airstrip, the camp caters to honeymooners, families, and small groups, offering spacious accommodations for up to two adults and three children. Celebrate romance with private bush dinners or embark on daily adventures to witness resident and migratory wildlife. Whether it s the thrill of a game drive or the simple joy of watching the sun set over the plains, this camp redefines safari elegance. There is WiFi accessible in main areas.

GAME DRIVES
Wildlife viewing and bird watching game drives within the central Serengeti are offered twice per day. Experienced guides encourage guests to see and experience the Serengeti through their eyes, sharing a world of small and large wonders that only they truly know and understand.
BALLOON SAFARI
Balloon safaris are a romantic and evocative way of experiencing the wilderness of East Africa, as you silently fly over the plains teeming with herds of wildlife in the early morning. Typically, a balloon safari begins around 6 am and lasts for around 1-2 hours.  The safari is followed by a champagne breakfast in the bush, a fitting end to a memorable flight in the wild.
FAMILY SAFARIS
The family adventure of a lifetime begins at Naona Moru Camp! Families with children aged 5+ are welcome, with private safari vehicles guaranteed for groups of 4+ in low season. During high season, private vehicles are required for children under 12 at an extra cost. Our expert guides captivate all ages with wildlife insights, bush games, and stories of the wild.
WALKING SAFARIS
Explore the intriguing wilderness on foot with our in-house armed walking guide; follow the tracks, smell the herds on the breeze and hear the crunch of fauna underfoot. Our bush guides have a wealth of insightful experience and they will fascinate you with bush-wise facts, wildlife know-how, local customs and incredible stories of life in the wilderness.

Discover Nasikia Camps
Welcome to Safari Magic.
At Nasikia Camps, we welcome you into our family and our home, inviting you to experience the unparalleled beauty and magnificence of Tanzania. Rooted in the Swahili word ‘Nasikia’ —meaning I feel or I hear —our camps are designed to connect you deeply with the rhythms of nature and the calls of the wild.
From the moment you arrive, our Nasikia family is dedicated to making your stay unforgettable. We aim to blend heartfelt hospitality, rich cultural experiences, and breathtaking wildlife encounters to ensure your journey is as remarkable as the land itself.
Feel at home in our camps as you savor traditional cuisine, bask in warm smiles, and immerse yourself in Tanzania’s vibrant culture. Whether you have special requests or simply want to share an idea, our team is here to make your safari dreams a reality—embracing the challenges of our unique and remote environment with passion and care.

Camps and Lodges
Little Moru
Tucked behind Nyaroboru Hill with stunning views of the Musabi Plains, this intimate camp offers just six tents for a classic safari experience. Evenings around the campfire, hot bucket showers, and starlit skies set the scene. The fertile plains nearby attract abundant wildlife, including the endangered Black Rhino and passing migration herds on their Serengeti journey.
Explore Little Moru
Naona Moru Camp
Nestled near the Moru Kopjes, Naona Moru Camp blends Arabian-inspired décor with modern comforts like hot showers and verandahs for stunning sunset views. Its prime location allows easy access to the Seronera Valley, remote eastern plains, and walking tours to Maasai rock art and instruments. Perfect for honeymooners, families, and small groups, it’s a serene base to explore the Serengeti year-round.
Explore Naona Moru Camp
Kaskaz Mara Camp
Kaskaz Mara Camp offers an exceptional base for exploring the iconic Mara River and witnessing the great migration. Its ten thoughtfully designed suites feature spacious interiors and handcrafted Swahili décor, providing comfort and connection to the wild. Immerse yourself with guided walking safaris, bush explorations, and experiencing the Serengeti up close.
Explore Kaskaz Mara Camp
Nasikia Mobile Migration Camp (Kogatende)
Nasikia Mobile Migration Camp offers an intimate safari experience with just ten mobile tents, carefully positioned to follow the wildebeest migration throughout the year. From June to October, the camp is located in the northern Serengeti near Kogatende, providing prime access to the Mara and Bologonja Rivers, where the dramatic river crossings unfold. Each spacious tent features handcrafted furniture and thoughtful amenities, blending comfort with a deep connection to the surrounding wilderness.
Explore Kogatende
Nasikia Mobile Migration Camp (Ndutu NCAA)
From December to March, the Nasikia Mobile Migration camp is set in the Small Marsh area of Ndutu in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, offering front-row access to the calving season and incredible predator activity. Each spacious tent, made from durable rip-stop canvas, offers a comfortable retreat with handmade furniture, mosquito-netted beds, and thoughtful amenities, all designed to harmonize with the natural beauty of the surroundings.
Explore Ndutu
Tarangire Ndovu Tented Lodge
Tarangire Ndovu Tented Lodge offers an authentic safari experience surrounded by Tanzania’s vast landscapes and iconic baobab trees. Known for its massive elephant herds and remote wilderness, the park offers a more intimate alternative to the northern circuit’s busier destinations. With 12 permanent tents, including standard suites and family accommodations, the lodge provides a year-round haven, especially during the dry season when elephants gather around permanent water sources within the park.
Explore Tarangire Ndovu Tented Lodge
Mandhari Lodge
Perched high on the Manyara Escarpment, Mandhari Lodge offers stunning panoramic views across Lake Natron, the Monduli Mountains, and Lake Manyara. The lodge features nine glass-fronted suites and a honeymoon nest, all with unobstructed vistas of the surrounding landscape. Built using 100% locally sourced materials, Mandhari blends modern comfort with environmental respect, offering an open, eucalypt platform with hand-crafted furnishings, a bar, dining area, and a swimming pool, all immersed in the beauty of the Great Rift Valley.
Explore Mandhari Lodge
